transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my family and friends... they keep saying these bank papers prove nothing was taken from me. But I know what's really going on. For over a year now, I’ve known they’re hiding my money. They just use things like bills, or these fundraisers, and talking about trip plans to cover it all up. So, I have to keep confronting them about it. I just have to keep pushing until they finally tell the truth.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't hear or see?
No, I haven't. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. It's just... I just know what they're doing with my money.
Aside from this frustration with your money, how has your mood been overall?
My mood is mostly just normal. I mean... I don't feel sad or anything like that. I'm just really tired of them lying to me. But if you take all that away, I feel fine.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological conditions?
No, I haven't. I don't have any medical problems or... brain issues, if that's what you mean. I've never been told I have anything like that. I'm physically fine.
